scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --target node && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format cjs --target node && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --target node --watch & bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format cjs --target node --watch & wait
